title: Adapting models to concept drift
text: stream processed batches 50 observations. batch first used test current model given fit(), updates model . classifier naive Bayes model daltoolbox. dfr_inactive() never reports drift, model keeps accumulating data concepts. dfr_ddm() monitors mistakes classifier. drift detected, model needs warmup_size observations trained , accuracy missing one batch.
code: run_stream <- function(detector) {   model <- stealthy(cla_nb("target", c("FALSE", "TRUE")), detector, warmup_size = 100)   results <- NULL   for (b in 2:max(batch)) {     train <- batch == (b - 1)     test <- batch == b     model <- fit(model, x[train, ], y[train, , drop = FALSE])      accuracy <- NA     if (model$fitted) {       prediction <- predict(model, x[test, ])       accuracy <- mean((prediction[, 2] > 0.5) == (y$target[test] == "TRUE"))     }     results <- rbind(results, data.frame(batch = b, drifted = model$drifted, accuracy = accuracy))   }   results } without_detector <- run_stream(dfr_inactive()) with_ddm <- run_stream(dfr_ddm())  with_ddm[with_ddm$drifted, ] #>    batch drifted accuracy #> 9     10    TRUE       NA #> 17    18    TRUE       NA #> 20    21    TRUE       NA #> 23    24    TRUE       NA #> 25    26    TRUE       NA plot(without_detector$batch, without_detector$accuracy,   type = "b", pch = 16,   ylim = c(0.4, 1), col = "grey50", xlab = "batch", ylab = "accuracy" ) lines(with_ddm$batch, with_ddm$accuracy, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "steelblue") abline(v = 750 / 50 + 0.5, lty = 2, col = "grey70") legend("bottomleft", c("dfr_inactive()", "dfr_ddm()"),   col = c("grey50", "steelblue"),   pch = 16, bty = "n", cex = 0.8 ) after <- with_ddm$batch > 16 c(   without_detector = mean(without_detector$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE),   with_ddm = mean(with_ddm$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE) ) #> without_detector         with_ddm  #>        0.4457143        0.9100000

title: Getting started with heimdall
text: Every detector follows three rules: update_state(obj, value) processes one observation returns list updated detector (obj) flag (drift) telling whether drift detected call; obj$drifted sticky: stays TRUE first detection; reset_state(obj) returns detector initial state, usually right drift handled. loop canonical way running detector stream. works unchanged detector package.
code: detect <- function(model, stream) {   output <- list(obj = model, drift = FALSE)   drifts <- integer(0)   for (i in seq_along(stream)) {     output <- update_state(output$obj, stream[i])     if (output$drift) {       drifts <- c(drifts, i)       output$obj <- reset_state(output$obj)     }   }   drifts }

code: # Load Heimdall and the built-in synthetic stream. library(heimdall)  # Fix the seed so the results are reproducible. seed <- 1 set.seed(seed)  # Load the stream and derive the binary monitored signal. data(st_drift_examples) data <- st_drift_examples$uv_virtual_drift data$prediction <- st_drift_examples$uv_virtual_drift$serie > 4  # Visualize the binary stream that EDDM will monitor. plot(x=seq_len(nrow(data)), y=data$prediction)   # Instantiate the EDDM detector. model <- dfr_eddm()  # Process the stream sequentially and store each detected alarm. detection <- NULL output <- list(obj=model, drift=FALSE) for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))){   output <- update_state(output$obj, data$prediction[i])   if (output$drift){     type <- 'drift'     output$obj <- reset_state(output$obj)   } else {     type <- ''   }   detection <- rbind(detection, data.frame(idx=i, event=output$drift, type=type)) }  # Print the drift alarms returned by EDDM. detection[detection$type == 'drift',] #>     idx event  type #> 231 231  TRUE drift  # Show those alarms on top of the original numeric series. plot(x=seq_len(nrow(data)), y=data$serie) for (drift_index in detection[detection$type == 'drift', 'idx']) {   abline(v=drift_index, col='red', lty=2) }
